Open the study behind a dataset

Source: R/browse_project.R
browse_project.Rd

Prints the study a dataset came from, the other datasets it produced, and the repository holding its processing code, then opens that repository in a browser.

Usage

browse_project(x, open = TRUE)

Arguments

x

A dataset alias (see list_datasets()) or a project slug (see list_projects()).

open

Logical. If TRUE (default), open the repository in a browser when one is registered and the session is interactive.

Value

The repository URL, invisibly, or NULL when no repository is registered for the project.

Details

Pipelines are published as repositories rather than as single scripts, because one study normally produces several datasets across many files. Some repositories are private and open only for Insper Cidades members; list_projects() reports which.

Examples

# By dataset alias
browse_project("sinistros_sp", open = FALSE)
#> 
#> ── Faixa Azul e sinistros de trânsito ──────────────────────────────────────────
#> Project: "faixa_azul"
#> Datasets: "faixa_azul_sp", "sinistros_sp", and "sinistros_via_sp"
#> Repository: <https://github.com/inspercidades/faixa-azul>

# By project slug
browse_project("motiva", open = FALSE)
#> 
#> ── Embarques nas estações operadas pela Motiva ─────────────────────────────────
#> Project: "motiva"
#> Datasets: "embarques_hora", "embarques_diarios", "embarques_mensais",
#> "embarques_integracao", "linhas_motiva", and "estacoes_motiva"
#> Repository: <https://github.com/inspercidades/pipeline-motiva>
#> ! This repository is private. Opening it needs an Insper Cidades GitHub account.
